reviews.text: Lovely people and always super nice to my dog!
Thank you very much for the kind appreciation!
We do our best so that you find us worthy of 5 stars next time.

An update: I now live in Eindhoven and am so impressed with Dr. Alba and her team that I will be going to them from now on all the way from Eindhoven. *That is how good they are!!!!*

I am very impressed with Dr. Alba LaFuerte’s care with my dog and even with me. I can be a pretty anxious parent and she was calm and direct with me while being very thorough with my dog who absolutely needed care with something lodged in his ear. The rest of the staff, Eva (the vets assistant) and Daphne, who works up front were absolutely cordial, kind and helpful as well. Thank you team!! So grateful for your care and compassion with me and Malcolm.
Thank you for your warm appreciation!

A city practice with a positive village mentality! I was able to take our tomcat right away, and they made a plan of action. They were very helpful, considering it was a rather unusual situation. They discussed the costs beforehand, and we left the tomcat with peace of mind. The assistant was friendly and the vet was very young and female. I could tell she was knowledgeable in her explanations and approach.
The price was average. Not expensive or cheap. I definitely recommend this practice.
They are always there for you. They are kind, committed, and skilled.

We have had fantastic experiences so far with the very skilled veterinarians Drs. Winnius and Drs. De Bruin; what wonderful people with a huge heart for animals!!

They really take their time and look very closely at the individual, listen and ask follow-up questions, and also explain their thought process very clearly. So happy that we are being helped here!
Received such a sweet ♥️ card after the passing of our sweet cat Moesje! Very dedicated veterinary team!! Thank you so much for taking such good care of Moesje!!
Our dog Delta always goes here with great pleasure. Very friendly staff who truly care about the animal.
Incredibly sweet and dedicated veterinarians and assistants who put in tremendous effort for the animals they treat.
Nice clinic with friendly and sweet veterinarians/assistants.

Good, fast service, and it was no problem that our cat wasn't in the mood; we were able to get an appointment a little later in the afternoon. A lovely, empathetic vet (a Spanish lady) who handled our sometimes difficult little guy well. Excellent advice to get him back on his feet.

We find you to be dedicated doctors and assistants. Our Jessy and Noxy are happy with this team. They feel safe.

If anything is wrong, we are allowed to come in, which is very nice.

My cat gave birth some days ago and today she delivered another baby kitten, unfortunately the new born kitten wasn’t breathing normally and also refused to nurse from his mother , I thought there is some fluids inside his lungs and took him here asap without an appointment and I'm not even registered with the clinic “just googles the nearest open vet” , they were really responsive and the doctor examined the baby kitten to deliver some bad news about him not gonna live long 😢 she was supportive and kind and didn’t ask or take any money.
A big thanks for your help 🤍
If I could give less than one star, I would have given it to this veterinarian with great pleasure.
Thank you very much for the card regarding Noah's passing. So special and so personal. It means a lot to us.
